title: 📊 Daily Report: Tue Nov 17, 2026
text:
Swing book: equity $17,382.37. Week so far (vs Nov 13 close base): -$379.76 (CORE -$357.04, strategies -$22.72). Since the merge: book -$2,638.37 (-13.18%) vs SPY (Indy) -$1,186.34 (-5.92%), a gap of -$1,452.03.
Traded today: only Trek (ACN sold on a trailing stop, -$20.98). Swing scans sat out (SPY below its 200-day average).
CORE QQQ: trend ON (month-end close Oct 30 690.49 vs 200-day 678.37), $10,393 held (60% of book), P&L -$2,297.30 all-time, -$357.04 this week. Since the Nov 16 switch: CORE -1.11%, old rule 0.00% (cash), SPY -2.15%.
Benched (Trek/Rota/Sunny): real positions still running off: 2 open (VRSN, PSX, per the Nov 15 list). Shadow trades so far: Trek 5 (0 on-time / 5 late), Rota 3 (0/3), Sunny 1 (0/1).
Desktop shadow: DIFFERENCES: 2 DIFF, 1 desktop-only, 0 box-only/TIMING. Desktop heartbeat 4 min old. Gate "SIT OUT" count differs (box 1, desktop 2); Trek ACN sell was 24.7 min later on the box (10:24 vs 10:00, $240.37 vs $243.56); desktop sold VRSN at 10:05 (trailing stop, -$14.48) and the box did not. All line up with box freezes: the box had a 37.7 min gap ending 10:24 plus 17 catch-up ticks today.
Engine timing: the box froze repeatedly today (gaps of 49 min ending 3:26 PM, 45 min midday, 28 min ending 1:01 PM, 12.5 min ending 3:43 PM). First tick landed 9:34 AM (OK), but the 10:30 and 1:00 scans were deferred by catch-up ticks and ran at 10:35 and 1:02 (about 5 and 2 min late); the 3:45 tick landed 3:45 (OK). Delayed trades: the ACN exit (about 25 min) and the VRSN exit not taken on the box. No CORE skips file.
Change notes:
2026-11-17: Fixed a bug where a late swing scan could run twice in a row; a deferred scan now runs once (tested, engine restarted Nov 16 6:17 PM ET).
2026-11-17: New safety kill switch is live: Ryan or the CEO can halt new trades (level 1) or close everything (level 2) with one command, and it trips itself if the book falls 3% from the prior close in a day (no trips so far; broker-side stops were built but stay OFF).
2026-11-17: Kill switch refined: in a halt, CORE can still sell or exit to cash but can't buy; an automatic 3% loss-cap halt now lifts itself at the next morning's open (a halt set by hand still needs a manual reset). Also fixed a mirror bug that would have stopped broker orders from being copied (the mirror stays off).
Research's analyst note (2026-11-17): Second straight down day (Dow -1.6%, S&P -1.0%, Nasdaq -0.7%). CRM -9.6% on tech and AI worries; managed care fell on a proposed anti-fraud rule (UNH -5.4%, HUM -3.9%), group stays in avoid through 11/20. ACM held its earnings gap (+11.4%), conditional long logged; DIS idea voided. NVDA reports after the bell, so chip/AI avoids stay on. Next: TGT, LOW, TJX before the open Wednesday, FOMC minutes at 2 PM, PANW after the close.
Claude impact: nothing new today. Four questions are queued for tonight's 8:05 PM ET batch; earlier advice (safety items, CORE rule test, benching of the three bots) is in place and CORE is -1.11% vs SPY -2.15% since its switch.
